name: Antigravity CLI (agy)
install: curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 20 --retry 3 --speed-limit 1000 --speed-time 60 https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh | bash && if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ "$(node -v | cut -d. -f1 | tr -d v)" -lt 22 ]; then curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 20 --retry 3 --speed-limit 1000 --speed-time 60 https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | bash - && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs; fi && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" agy plugin install https://github.com/Domush/antigravity-plugin-context-mode && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" agy plugin install https://github.com/ahmetdotsh/agy-context && npm i -g antigravity-usage

description.pt: Agente do Google, sucessor do Gemini CLI.
description.en: Google's agent, successor to Gemini CLI.

note.pt: Entre com a conta Google; na primeira vez, o chat abre o terminal para colar o código.
note.en: Sign in with your Google account; the first time, the chat opens the terminal for you to paste the code.
